roles.headline: Quantile pricing for truckload freight, and agentic tooling for the data science team.
highlights: Build quantile pricing models with group-wise and global conformal calibration, with automated reporting against production and development.
Built experimentation and backtesting pipelines for the existing pricing engines, and showed gains with a single, interpretable alternative.
Set up Snowflake, Azure ML, FastAPI, Streamlit, and Docker with packaged Claude Code and Cursor configurations for secure tool access across environments.
Wrote agentic skills that turn scientists' notebooks into secure, branded apps on shared infrastructure at no added cost, with scheduled offline reports delivered through Slack.

roles.headline: Technical lead and owner of the Databricks and Azure ML platform behind forecasting, delivery-time prediction, inventory replenishment, and labor planning for an e-commerce fulfillment network.
highlights: Replaced hundreds of site-specific Prophet and ARIMA models with one ML forecasting engine, cutting daily weighted error from about 30% to 15%.
Built delivery-time prediction for 100M+ orders a year with quantile regression and conformal calibration, and demand forecasting across 1M+ series every week.
Built simulation and backtesting engines for forecasting, replenishment, and delivery estimates, so models were judged on business KPIs before release.

Shipped a delivery-estimate service on a tight deadline to onboard a multi-billion-dollar account: distilled the model into a static lookup that kept 80% of the modeled lift, and load-tested it with Docker Compose and Locust.
Set engineering standards (git, CI/CD, linting, tests, backtests) across about 50 data science repositories, and wrote interview case studies used in dozens of senior and staff interviews.
Took 2nd place in the company AI hackathon (December 2025) with a one-day agentic, multimodal demand forecasting app for cold-start products, built with CrewAI, CLIP embeddings, and RAG.

roles.headline: Owned the models behind real-time freight pricing, where accuracy and uptime had direct financial consequences.
highlights: Owned training and reporting pipelines for the Book It Now, Market Rate, and Market Cost pricing services.
Led automated tender acceptance, and built a baseline market-cost model that matched the production ensemble on standard orders using only five shipment features.
Built REST services on AKS with batch endpoints and SHAP-based explanations for human review.
Interviewed, hired, and mentored as the data science team grew from 2 people to more than 10.

roles.headline: Built pricing and recommendation models that held up in production.
highlights: Deployed pricing models built on gradient boosting, quantile regression forests, and ensembles.
Tuned recommendation models for freight matching and measured their lift in production.
Automated a network optimization that matched empty UPS trucks with Coyote freight.
Shipped explainability endpoints that turned model outputs into readable reasons for operators.

roles.headline: Forecasting and experimentation for a freight brokerage.
highlights: Built account-level forecasts with SARIMAX and ETS, and automated the pipelines that refreshed them.
Automated freight-matching workflows in R and Python with DBAs, scientists, and engineers.
Designed and ran A/B tests of recommendation approaches in a live matching app.

roles.headline: Predictive modeling for debt collection, where positive outcomes were rare.
highlights: Built classification and regression models for payment likelihood and expected value on highly imbalanced data, across healthcare, utility, and other portfolios.
Deployed a scoring workflow for new placements and tuned collection strategy from the results.
